## What and why

Describe the problem, behaviour change and related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] Lint, typecheck, unit tests and production build
- [ ] Documentation links, secret-pattern scan and dependency audit
- [ ] Regression tests added/updated where appropriate
- [ ] Mobile (360px/375px), desktop and keyboard checks for UI work
- [ ] Own test backend/accounts only; no production credentials or user data

List actual commands/results and anything not tested. Add redacted before/after screenshots for visual changes.

## Database / configuration / deployment

List new migrations in order, environment or provider settings, data impact, upgrade steps and rollback considerations. Write “none” if unchanged. Applying SQL is separate from a code deployment.

## Risks / known limits

Describe compatibility, security, accessibility, performance and licensing considerations. Do not disclose vulnerabilities or sensitive data publicly; follow SECURITY.md.

## Contribution rights

- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under the project license; third-party material is identified with its license/provenance.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for secrets, personal data and unrelated changes.
